collection.credit:
NEW EVENTS - VILLAGE MOMENTS (VFX-01..12, draft for the owner, 2026-11-18)
Songs, chants and speeches, a long lazy afternoon, rain on the way, a roof patched with cloth: small moments where the whole village does something together, and the island answers.
Written in the style of the owner's own events. Edit anything and send it back; nothing ships until you approve.

collection.description: A visiting teacher: learn all she knows, or ask a few careful questions.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: A wise woman from a far island has stopped in the village for a few days. She knows more about her craft than anyone on Isola, and she offers to teach. (name1) has to decide what the village should learn from her.

o1.name: Outcome A
o1.text: (name1) and the others sit with her from morning to night. When she leaves, the village knows things it never knew before, and it shows in everything they do.

text_only.reason: technology talked about in the story; no tech points change -- the draft's notes: everything but the marked effects is story only

o2.name: Outcome B
o2.text: (name1) asks her a few careful questions over a meal. Her answers are short and useful, and (name1) writes down every word.
